import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from parallel_linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
def run(rank, ws, port):
    os.environ['MASTER_ADDR']='127.0.0.1'; os.environ['MASTER_PORT']=str(port)
    dist.init_process_group('gloo', rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    I,O=8,12
    W=torch.randn(O,I); x=torch.randn(3,5,I,requires_grad=True)
    ref=torch.nn.Linear(I,O); ref.weight.data.copy_(W); ref.bias.data.zero_()
    xr=x.detach().clone().requires_grad_(); yr=ref(xr); yr.sum().backward()
    for cls in (ColumnParallelLinear,RowParallelLinear):
        m=cls(I,O,True,W); xx=x.detach().clone().requires_grad_()
        y=m(xx); y.sum().backward()
        assert torch.allclose(y,yr,atol=1e-5)
        assert torch.allclose(xx.grad,xr.grad,atol=1e-5)
        if cls is ColumnParallelLinear:
            s=slice(rank*O//ws,(rank+1)*O//ws)
            assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad,ref.weight.grad[s],atol=1e-5)
            assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad,ref.bias.grad[s],atol=1e-5)
        else:
            s=slice(rank*I//ws,(rank+1)*I//ws)
            assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad,ref.weight.grad[:,s],atol=1e-5)
            assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad,ref.bias.grad,atol=1e-5)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__=='__main__':
    for i,ws in enumerate((1,2,4)):
        mp.spawn(run,args=(ws,29600+i),nprocs=ws); print('ok',ws)
